summary: AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric utility, filed a Form 6-K reporting a Board-approved partial mandatory redemption of 576,923 of its outstanding Class C preferred shares (PNC Shares), representing ~0.0951% of such shares, for an aggregate R$30,000,000.00 (implied price per share R$52.00). Holders may elect to convert redeemed PNC Shares into common shares at a 1.1:1 ratio (Partial Elective Conversion), though ADS holders are excluded from conversion. The redemption is pro rata, with fractional entitlements disregarded. Redemption occurs July 7, 2026; ADS payment follows later. This is a partial return of capital, not an issuer tender for all shares. Watch for treatment of fractional ADS positions.
